title: Prediction scoring runs on the tree that carries the absorbed fix, so a right prediction scores INCORRECT
body: scorePredictions runs at close-out admission (dispatch.go:317), after the absorbed fix closed, and gating.ScorePrediction labels a pass INCORRECT. A correct prediction whose fix worked is therefore recorded as wrong, and only a failed fix scores CORRECT. The calibration set gvc promised is systematically mislabelled toward 'raise the threshold'. Score against the commit the finding stood on (before the absorbed tick integrated), or record the result unscoreable, and update score_test.go:156.
